opts: module TestCircuit (A, B, C, clock, X, Y);input A;input B;input C;input clock;output X;output Y;reg X;reg Y;always @(posedge clock) X <= A | B;always @(B or C) Y = B & C; endmodule
module TestCircuit (A, B, C, clock, X, Y);input A;input B;input C;input clock;output X;output Y;reg X;reg Y;always @(posedge clock) X <= A | B;always @(posedge clock) Y = B & C; endmodule
